sites.name: Po Nagar Towers
sites.event: The largest remaining Cham Pa architectural complex in Central Vietnam, dedicated to the worship of goddess Po Ina Nagar (Thien Y Ana - Mother of the Land) of the Cham people.

sites.name: Long Son Pagoda (White Buddha Pagoda)
sites.event: Famous for the largest outdoor seated statue of Kim Than Phat To (White Buddha) in Vietnam (at the time of construction) on the peak of Trai Thuy Hill.

sites.name: Dien Khanh Ancient Citadel
sites.event: A military citadel built by Lord Nguyen Anh in 1793, which witnessed many fierce battles between the Tay Son and Nguyen dynasties.

sites.name: Nha Trang Institute of Oceanography
sites.event: The earliest marine scientific research institution established in Vietnam (in 1922), housing tens of thousands of marine life specimens.

sites.name: Hon Chong - Hon Vo
sites.event: A natural cluster of stacked rocks, associated with the legend of a giant five-finger imprint deeply pressed into the stone.

sites.name: Mui Doi
sites.event: The easternmost point on mainland Vietnam, where the country welcomes its very first sunrise.

sites.name: Binh Ba Island (Lobster Island)
sites.event: An island famous for lobster farming and pristine landscapes, which was once a military area restricted to foreigners.

sites.name: Tomb of Doctor Alexandre Yersin
sites.event: The resting place of the great French scientist - an honorary citizen of Vietnam, who discovered the plague bacillus and explored the Lam Vien Plateau.

sites.name: Diep Son Island
sites.event: Famous for its unique underwater walking path (about 700m long) connecting the islands when the tide recedes.

sites.name: Nha Trang Cathedral (Stone Church)
sites.event: A beautiful Western Gothic architectural work built of stone during the French colonial period (1928).

sites.name: Yang Bay Waterfall
sites.event: Meaning 'Heaven's Waterfall' in the Raglai language, it is located in the middle of a majestic primary forest and is closely associated with Raglai culture.

sites.name: Yen Island (Hon Noi)
sites.event: Home to a unique twin beach (one side hot, one side cold) and the largest natural bird's nest harvesting site, featuring the Temple of the Bird's Nest Craft Founders.
